_about: Public-domain Rudolf Stier (1800-1862, German Lutheran pastor and exegete) in pre-1930 English translations from T. & T. Clark, raw Internet Archive OCR: The Words of the Lord Jesus (8 vols, tr. William B. Pope, a mixed set of 1863-67 printings), The Words of the Risen Saviour with a commentary on James (tr. Pope, 1864) and The Words of the Apostles Expounded (tr. G. H. Venables, 1869). Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 16 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
